title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30081: add VAT registration number override event
summary: An integration event allows extensions to override VAT registration number formatting in Intrastat reports before standard concatenation logic runs.
key_points: New OnBeforeGetVATRegNo integration event added to IntrastatReportManagement codeunit
Event enables subscribers to provide correct VAT ID and bypass standard formatting
Solves issue where stored VAT registration numbers including country prefix caused invalid partner VAT IDs
Includes IsHandled parameter for subscribers to skip standard logic
